title: Redis Setup
last_note: Deviated from ticket's literal /infra path — used src/infra to match the actual location docker-compose.yml already lives at (established in T004/T007). Verified live: docker compose up -d redis, confirmed maxmemory=268435456 (256mb), maxmemory-policy=allkeys-lru, save="", databases=16 via redis-cli CONFIG GET, then stopped/removed the container. redis.conf mounted read-only; added an explicit `command: ["redis-server", "/usr/local/etc/redis/redis.conf"]` override since mounting the file alone does not make the stock image's entrypoint read it. src/infra/README.md created fresh (did not exist before) documenting DB 0 = Discovery cache, DB 1 = SignalR backplane.
